question: Which of the following statements CORRECTLY distinguishes a switch from a hub?
options: A switch operates at Layer 1; a hub operates at Layer 2
A switch broadcasts all frames; a hub filters based on MAC addresses
A switch uses MAC addresses to forward frames; a hub broadcasts to all ports
A switch and hub function identically but differ only in port count
A switch connects different IP networks; a hub connects only same IP networks
answer: A switch uses MAC addresses to forward frames; a hub broadcasts to all ports

question: A technician extends a network cable run that has exceeded its maximum length. Which device should be used to regenerate the signal without any filtering capability?
A company is setting up a shared Ethernet network using a hub. What will happen when Device A sends a frame to Device B?
options: Only Device B will receive the frame
Only Device A and Device B will exchange the frame privately
All devices connected to the hub will receive the frame
The hub will buffer the frame and forward it only during low traffic
The hub will check the MAC address table and forward only to Device B
answer: All devices connected to the hub will receive the frame
